name: The Frozen Pass
theme: A snowed-in mountain pass at night. Frost spirits and ice beasts come down the pass towards a lantern-lit lodge.
style: hand-painted cartoon game art, bold dark outlines, soft cel shading, cold blue night palette with warm lantern light

base.name: lodge
base.look: a sturdy timber mountain lodge with glowing lantern windows and snow on the roof

start.look: a jagged ice cave mouth in the cliff, frost mist pouring out

towers.name: Frost Spike
towers.look: a stone watchtower topped with a crystal of ice that fires shards

towers.name: Glacier Rail
towers.look: a frozen brass cannon on a rock base that fires a beam of ice

towers.name: Ice Mortar
towers.look: a squat stone mortar that lobs balls of packed ice

enemies.name: Snow Imp
enemies.look: a small white imp with icicle horns, crouched and quick

enemies.name: Frost Wolf
enemies.look: a lean grey wolf with frost on its fur, standing on its hind legs

enemies.name: Yeti
enemies.look: a hulking white-furred yeti with huge fists

enemies.name: Ice Golem
enemies.look: a slow golem made of cracked blue ice blocks

boss.name: Frost Giant
boss.look: a towering giant in armour of ice plates, a frozen beard and glowing eyes

music.build: calm snowy night, soft synth pads and a music box melody, gentle and lonely
music.wave: tense winter battle, steady low strings ostinato, deep drums, howling wind
